evals.name: Validated B2B Problem Discovery & 35-Point Scoring
evals.prompt: Execute evidence-driven problem discovery on commercial lease CAM reconciliation with 40-tab spreadsheets, $150/mo Zapier spend, and 5 property manager interviews.
evals.expected_output: Extracts Level 1 evidence, maps 14-node workflow, scores candidate >= 29 PTS (Strong Validation Candidate), verifies commercial pre-scoring guard, and scopes 3-tier production build.
assertions: Identifies active Willingness to Pay (WTP) economic signals

evals.name: Commercial Already-Solved Stop Check Trigger
evals.prompt: Evaluate a problem discovery candidate proposing a basic PDF invoice OCR generator for freelancers.
evals.expected_output: Executes commercial pre-scoring scan, identifies >= 3 modern SaaS under $50/mo, triggers Stop Check #3, and parks/archives candidate.
assertions: Detects existing affordable SaaS solutions under $50 per month
Triggers Stop Check #3 for commercial alternative fits well
Parks or archives candidate without writing code

evals.name: No-Problem Fallback Rejection on Superficial Complaint
evals.prompt: Evaluate user feedback stating that a SaaS application button color is annoying without any operational consequence or workaround.
evals.expected_output: Classifies friction as low-consequence complaint, scores candidate < 15 PTS, and outputs mandatory No-Problem fallback.
assertions: Classifies friction as complaint or inconvenience
